answer: A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The mesa counter is kept in shale and zenith shows each reset. A hostile operator hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1082 identities would post 2317 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
